set_text.text: Material markup is the percentage added to what goods cost you, to set their selling price. The term is common in contracting, where materials are marked up on a job. For a distributor the material is the case, costed all the way to your dock.
Everything you pay to get the case onto your dock and ready to ship: the supplier price, freight in and handling. The markup goes on top of that total.
Rent, sales pay, insurance and the office. They belong to the business, not the case, so the margin the markup leaves has to pay for them.
The $1.40 to bring a case in is part of its cost. The truck that takes it to your account is a cost to serve, and it comes out of margin.
Who uses a material markup calculator
It is built for independent food distributors who buy product in and resell it by the case. Anyone who builds a case cost, sets the markup rule or tracks freight should run it.
